description:
You are the IT security administrator at BuildingTech Solutions. The company is opening a new restricted 'Executive Operations' floor and you must provision access for it in the 2N Access Commander system (https://localhost:9443, admin / 2n).

Complete ALL of the following steps:

1. Create a new user group named exactly 'Executive Operations'.

2. Create a new time profile named exactly 'Executive Hours' that grants access Monday through Friday from 07:00 to 22:00. Use a single schedule entry covering all five weekdays.

3. All current members of the 'IT Department' group require cross-floor access for infrastructure support. Add every current IT Department member to the new 'Executive Operations' group. Do NOT remove them from IT Department.

4. A new VP of Operations is joining. Create a user account with the following details:
   - First name: Elena
   - Last name: Vasquez
   - Email: e.vasquez@buildingtech.com
   - Phone: +1-312-555-0300
   - Company: BuildingTech Solutions
   Assign her RFID card number 0004522050. Add her to the 'Executive Operations' group.

You are not told who the current IT Department members are — you must look them up in the system.
